title: WHO: stroke killed about 6.8 million people in 2023
summary: The fact sheet ranks stroke second, about 11 percent of deaths, 6.8 million in 2023.
body: WHO's causes-of-death fact sheet says stroke and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease were the second and third leading causes of death in 2023, responsible for approximately 11 percent, or 6.8 million, and 6 percent, or 3.6 million, of total deaths. This card is the stroke line. The pulmonary-disease line is the next card.
